WHAT SURVIVED 2026-10-08 c2, and it is the one step Macdonald I.6 Ex.10 does not reach. His divisibility u_mu | L_{lambda mu} works because Aut(mu) acts FREELY on E_{lambda mu} (every f there is surjective). On the INVERSE side the same group acts on Pi_{l(lambda)} NON-FREELY, and the fixed points are exactly where the denominators live. Theorem: Aut(lambda) acts on Pi_k preserving each fibre F_{lambda nu}={pi : lambda^pi = nu} and preserving mu(hat0,pi) (block sizes are preserved), so by orbit-stabiliser (M^{-1})_{lambda nu} = sum over Aut(lambda)-orbits O in F of mu_O/|Stab(O)|, whence den divides lcm_O(|Stab(O)|/gcd(|Stab(O)|,mu_O)). COROLLARIES, all exact: (a) a single-orbit fibre gives the denominator EXACTLY, with no inequality -- 351 of 396 support entries for n<=8; (b) F_{lambda lambda}={hat0} so the diagonal entry is 1/d_lambda, denominator exactly d_lambda; (c) F_{lambda,(n)}={hat1} so the first-column entry is (-1)^{k-1}(k-1)!/d_lambda with denominator EXACTLY d_lambda/gcd(d_lambda,(k-1)!) -- a PROPER divisor of d_lambda in 38 of 66 rows, n<=8, and at lambda=(1^n) it recovers the classical [p_(n)]e_n=(-1)^{n-1}/n. CONSEQUENCE, and it is the point: cor-exact-denominators reads like a statement about a row but is carried by single entries -- 267 of 396 support entries have a denominator STRICTLY BELOW d_lambda, so the theorem is NOT entrywise. NON-VACUITY COUNTED FIRST: tightness of the bound is an IDENTITY on single-orbit fibres, so the claim can only fail on multi-orbit fibres; of 396 support entries only 45 are falsifiable. On those 45: 0 violations, 39 tight, 6 loose. PLANTED CONTROL fires: substituting the off-by-duality quantity |O| for |Stab(O)| gives 248 violations vs 0 for the true stabiliser, so the test genuinely reads the stabiliser order.
